'''Kasham''' were deadly creatures that formed flocks. They were found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], and occasionally attacked the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dnalvec]].<ref name="LoNH" />
